subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw pursue a new Channel Broker SDK/bundled broker conformance boundary, or re-scope this work to the existing channel-outbound contract?
rationale: The requested harness depends on a public SDK and channel/plugin boundary that a linked implementation attempted but a repository member closed as too broad without prior design approval.

options.title: Require smaller design first
options.body: Keep this issue as product-direction pending and require any implementation to start from a maintainer-approved broker or channel-outbound boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow broker harness
options.body: Define the minimal supported `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-broker` contract and allow a focused conformance PR against that approved surface.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: If maintainers do not want a separate broker layer, close the broker issue cluster and direct future work to targeted improvements in existing channel contracts.

recommendation.title: Require smaller design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as product-direction pending and require any implementation to start from a maintainer-approved broker or channel-outbound boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest prior repository-member decision on the linked Channel Broker stack boundary.
